✨It’s Good Mornings✨

Welcome to @fortheloveofkittenrescue! My name is Mary (some call me Dr. Mary, PhD), and I am your host and creator of chaos. By day I am the President/Executive Director/Founder of Miss Dixie’s Kitten Rescue in South Carolina. By night I am usually asleep because I am in my thirties and we need our rest.

This channel (I hope) will take you on the journey of kitten rescue in the south. From vlogs to educational videos to just a silly goose time, I hope to bring awareness to the important work of animal rescue/welfare, teach you some things and laugh a little a long the way.

Enjoy!
